name: project-acceptance
description: Offline acceptance progress, verdict and human manual trial at 120x36. Prepare with scripts/prepare-accept-walk.ts; load its printed temporary extension directory with ui-walk --extension. Git runTool and fixed orchestration/record tool names are fixture-adapted; frontend-accept.test.ts covers the unadapted production path. Use /project new Acceptance --language en, /walk-prepare, /project spec (approve), /project implement (confirm base), F6, /project next (approve acceptance), /project accept; capture progress, then F6 and /project status for the verdict, /project next for the manual trial. No merge, ship or trial is automatic.
prompt: Review the approved local result independently, then inspect the human-only UI trial prompt.
